findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded when `I18n.translate` is called outside a controller request
findings.body: `I18n.translate` only loads `config.locale` (`load_locale(config.locale) unless @loaded_locales.include?(config.locale)`), while fallback locales are only loaded via `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` inside `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Any translation performed in a background job (Sidekiq), rake task, mailer, console, or test that does not go through `ApplicationController#set_locale`—or that passes an explicit `locale:` option to `I18n.t`—will not have the fallback locales (such as `SiteSetting.default_locale` or `:en`) loaded into `@loaded_locales`. Because Discourse's `translate_accelerator` patch suppresses automatic `load_translations`, `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` will look up keys in unloaded fallback locales and return missing-translation results instead of falling back.

findings.title: `Pluralization` is included before `Fallbacks`, breaking fallback when a locale has an incomplete pluralization table
findings.body: In `config/initializers/i18n.rb`, `I18n::Backend::Pluralization` is included into `I18n::Backend::Simple` before `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks`. In Ruby's ancestor chain, `Fallbacks#translate` will call `super`, which invokes `Pluralization#pluralize` on the result. However, if a translation key exists as a hash in the primary locale with a missing plural form (or if `i18n.plural.rule` is missing for the primary locale and falls back to `:en`'s rule, which returns a key like `:one` or `:other` not present in the partial locale hash), `I18n::InvalidPluralizationData` is raised and is not caught by `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` (which only rescues `I18n::MissingTranslationData`), causing a 500 error instead of falling back.

findings.title: String vs Symbol mismatch in `@loaded_locales` causes redundant reloading or missed loads
findings.body: `ApplicationController#set_locale` sets `I18n.locale` from `current_user.effective_locale` or `SiteSetting.default_locale` (which are Strings, and `I18n.config.locale` converts them to Symbols), whereas `FallbackLocaleList#[]` returns `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]`. If `ensure_loaded!` or `FallbackLocaleList#[]` is called with a String `locale` (e.g., `I18n.fallbacks["de"]`), `uniq` in `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq` will not deduplicate `"de"` and `:de`, and `@loaded_locales.include?(locale)` in `load_locale` will treat `"de"` and `:de` as distinct, loading all YAML files for that locale twice.
